rationale: I3b verdict 2 (operator R62): do not merge PR #47 at 2ebd6fe. AC2 (live tier passes) and AC4 (0 offline failures) are met. Unmet at head: AC1 — every tests/acceptance class still uses @unittest.skipUnless(_have_credentials()); AC3 — tests/acceptance/test_gw_self_serve.py prefixes from FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX with a 'gw-acc-' fallback and gitweave/{plan,reset}.py and managers/{teams,rulesets}.py let FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX override; AC5 — check_permission (gitweave/policy.py:106) is never called; AC6 — jsonschema absent from requirements.txt, ImportError fallback kept in policy.py. Review majors carried in: remove-member subcommand unregistered, PolicyError uncaught on the CLI path, fail-open on empty allow-lists. Each AC carries one falsifying check; the WI closes only when the whole-suite gate AND every check pass.

acceptanceCriteria.given: tests/acceptance with GW_CALLER_TOKEN unset (the other GW_* set)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the run FAILS naming GW_CALLER_TOKEN; no acceptance test uses skipUnless/skipTest/pytest.mark.skip on credentials

acceptanceCriteria.given: tests/acceptance with GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX unset (the other GW_* set)
the gitweave package and the live acceptance tests
acceptanceCriteria.when: searching gitweave/ and tests/acceptance/ for FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX or the 'gw-acc-' fallback
acceptanceCriteria.then: there is no match: every created resource name derives from GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX only (FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX is forge's gate-isolation var, not GitWeave's ownership marker)

argv: import subprocess,sys; r=subprocess.run(['grep','-rqnE','FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX|gw-acc-']+['gitweave', 'tests/acceptance']).returncode; sys.exit(0 if r==1 else 1)

acceptanceCriteria.given: a caller whose team policy.yaml does not permit the request type, name pattern or target repo
acceptanceCriteria.then: each gw self-serve CLI subcommand dispatch calls gitweave.policy.check_permission (asserted by spy, not by reimplemented inline checks) and the refusal message cites the denying rule; exit non-zero, nothing written to the org

acceptanceCriteria.given: a fresh install from requirements.txt or pyproject.toml
acceptanceCriteria.then: jsonschema is declared in both files; policy.py imports jsonschema unconditionally (no ImportError fallback / minimal validation path); a schema-invalid policy.yaml is rejected with a ValidationError-derived PolicyError
`gw self-serve remove-member` (or the documented subcommand name) is registered in the argparse tree and dispatches to self_serve_remove_member through check_permission

acceptanceCriteria.given: a missing or schema-invalid team policy.yaml
acceptanceCriteria.then: every self-serve CLI handler catches PolicyError (not only PolicyDenied) and exits non-zero with a one-line error naming the policy file; no traceback

acceptanceCriteria.given: a policy whose allowed_repo_patterns or allowed_exceptions is absent or empty
acceptanceCriteria.then: check_permission and the allowed_exceptions guard DENY (fail closed) and name the empty list; nothing is permitted by absence
